_locale_dict: copy: Record<Locale,{...,items:[{id,title,before,steps[],result,prefill}]}> (add en). item ids stay verbatim.

en.title: What is costing you unnecessary time today?
en.intro: Choose an example from your everyday work. Here is how it could become a simpler process.
en.note: An example, not a finished service promise. We clarify your systems, requirements and approvals together.

items.title: Requests get lost
items.before: Requests arrive through different channels. Important details are missing and follow-ups cost time.
items.result: An editable briefing instead of scattered notes – with a goal, open questions and a traceable next step.
items.prefill: I would like to organize my requests better. Today they arrive through different channels. I would like a clear briefing and a traceable next step.

items.title: Too much duplicate work
items.before: The same information is entered multiple times. Work gets stuck between email, file and system.
items.result: A clearly defined process: information is passed on purposefully; important decisions stay with the responsible people.
items.prefill: I would like to reduce duplicate data entry and recurring manual work. Please help me clarify the existing process and possible connections between my systems.

items.title: Information is scattered
items.before: Customers and team look for the current status. Responsibilities and next steps are not immediately clear.
items.result: An understandable workspace with the needed status, clear responsibilities and appropriate access rights.
items.prefill: I would like to make information accessible in one place for my team or my customers. A clear current status, responsibilities and appropriate access rights are important.
